# ICMPv4 (`icmpv4`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: 8 octets (fixed)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ipv4`](ipv4.md) | `protocol` | 1 (0x01) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `enum(8)` | `8` (echo_request) |   | Message type. |
| `code` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   | Message code, meaning depends on the type. |
| `checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Internet checksum over the header and everything after it |   |
| `rest` | `bytes(4)` | `00 00 00 00` |   | Type-specific 4-byte "rest of header" field. |

| Value | Name |

| 0 (0x00) | `echo_reply` |

| 5 (0x05) | `redirect` |
| 8 (0x08) | `echo_request` |
| 9 (0x09) | `router_advertisement` |
| 10 (0x0a) | `router_solicitation` |
| 11 (0x0b) | `time_exceeded` |
| 12 (0x0c) | `parameter_problem` |
| 13 (0x0d) | `timestamp_request` |
| 14 (0x0e) | `timestamp_reply` |
| 15 (0x0f) | `information_request` |
| 16 (0x10) | `information_reply` |
| 17 (0x11) | `address_mask_request` |
| 18 (0x12) | `address_mask_reply` |
| 42 (0x2a) | `extended_echo_request` |
| 43 (0x2b) | `extended_echo_reply` |
